findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_guides, list_projects, check_email_security, check_domain, check_ai_readiness, request_service, request_seo_check, search_site · Private data: check_fit, check_email_security, check_domain, check_ai_readiness, estimate_status · Public sink: list_guides, list_projects, request_callback, check_email_security, check_domain, check_ai_readiness, request_service, request_full_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_guides, list_projects, check_email_security, check_domain, check_ai_readiness, request_service, request_seo_check, search_site · Private data: check_fit, check_email_security, check_domain, check_ai_readiness, estimate_status · Public sink: list_guides, list_projects, request_callback, check_email_security, check_domain, check_ai_readiness, request_service, request_full_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
